# RPS Online 98 — legal pages

The published privacy policy, terms of service and account-deletion page for
the game **RPS Online 98**.

This repository exists only to host those four HTML files at a stable public
URL — one that stays reachable for someone who has already uninstalled the
app, and that does not depend on the game's backend being awake.

**Do not edit the files here.** The source of truth is `Docs/site/` in the
game repository; these are copies pushed from there.
